enrichment.core_claim: The feeling of free will is a conditioned illusion produced by superstitious operant learning from temporally contiguous premotor and motor activity under determinism.
enrichment.ask_question: What clinical or pharmacological conditions would you expect to disrupt the sense of free will most clearly?
enrichment.challenge_question: If the experience is learned, why does a sense of agency appear so early in infancy before extensive reinforcement history?
